messages.subject: Change line type in ggplot
parts:
Hi @all

I am quite a R newbie and I "wasted" the entire last weekend to find
out how to have more control over the line types and colours in
ggplot. I have the following code:

read.csv("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/4236038/test_series.csv") -> series
melt_series<-melt(series, id=c("Month"), na.rm=TRUE)
melt_series$Month <- as.Date(melt_series$Month)
ggplot(melt_series, aes(x = Month, y = value, group = variable)) +
geom_line(aes(color=variable), size=1) +
geom_point(aes(shape=variable), size=2.5) -> p
p + scale_x_date(format="%m/%Y", major = "3 months", minor = "1
month") + theme_bw() +
opts(legend.key=theme_rect(fill=NULL,colour="white")) +
opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank()) + opts(panel.grid.major =
theme_blank()) + xlab("Month") + ylab("Flow") +opts(axis.text.x =
theme_text(angle = 90)) + scale_colour_manual(values =
c("green","black"))+ scale_linetype_manual(values = c(1,1))

I tried to manage to control the colours of the individual lines but I
couldn't figure out how to control the line types, e.g. broken line
and solid line.

Is there a link to a website where I can find more information about
the control on lines and any idea how to get different line types for
my example?

Thanks in advance.

Martin

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Change line type in ggplot
parts:
Hi,

here is a minimal examples:

d <- data.frame(x = 1:3, y = c(1:3, 2:4), lt = gl(2,3, labels = letters[1:2]))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(x, y, linetype = lt)) + geom_line()

p + scale_linetype_manual(breaks = letters[1:2], values = c(1, 3))
p + scale_linetype_manual(breaks = letters[1:2], values = c("1343", "73"))

values indicates the linetype for the each value.
for more details of linetype, see Linetype Specification section in ?par.


--
Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

The University of  Tokyo, Japan.

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Change line type in ggplot
parts:
Hi,

set linetype in aes:

p <- ggplot(melt_series, aes(x = Month, y = value)) +
geom_line(aes(color=variable, linetype=variable), size=1) +
geom_point(aes(shape=variable), size=2.5)

if you want to specify how lines look, e.g.,

p + scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,5))

--
Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology,
The University of  Tokyo, Japan.
http://www.fennel.rcast.u-tokyo.ac.jp/profilee_ktakahashi.html
